# FilterChip

Toggle chips that narrow a list: pick any number in a group (pillars, energy tiers, rotation, tags), see how many tracks each one holds, and clear the group in…

`SongNodes.FilterChip` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.FilterChip legend="…" options={…} value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.FilterChip" legend="…" options="{{…}}" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (FilterChipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `legend` * | `string` | Group legend ("Pillar", "Energy tier"). |
| `options` * | `FilterChipOption[]` | Chips in fixed order. |
| `value` * | `string[]` | Selected values. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string[]) => void` | Called with the new selection. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | Show the "Clear (n)" button when anything is selected; default true. |

### FilterChipOption

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `string` | Stable value. |
| `label` * | `string` | Label in sentence case; for tiers use TIER_LABEL. |
| `count` | `number` | Number of matching items, shown in mono; 0 renders the empty style. |
| `tier` | `"low" \| "building" \| "high"` | Energy tier swatch for tier chips. |
| `emphasis` | `boolean` | Brand-soft emphasis while off (Rotation High). |
